frame: Campaign acceptance frame (S9 shell :3410, S10 shell :3411), fixture pages run-owned:theme-lab-visual-acceptance-imported-20260924 (search/history) and run-owned:sigma10-main (credit, with the capture's five-layer stack incl. saved-credit-component.css), candidate CSS injected as one <style> over the disabled runtime baseline link, W13 probe method; all browser work under the coord browser.lock.

class_G_search_overflow.defect: Revealed 8rem in-flow input is centred on the 23.4px search box; right edge = centre + 64px. Without fix: document overflow +29 (768), +41 (390), +43 (320), identical in S9 and S10 shells (matches the audits' containment facts exactly).
class_G_search_overflow.fix: At <=1024px the form becomes the positioning context on hover/focus-within and the revealed input is absolutely placed ending 1.75rem before the form's right edge (clear of the submit control), growing leftwards at the full 8rem width.
class_G_search_overflow.trial_note: In-flow narrowing was measured and rejected: 5rem left +5/+17/+19px; 70px left +12/+14px of document overflow at 390/320 from other content the wider form previously masked, and only ~70px of usable input. The absolute form leaves 0px at every width.
class_G_search_overflow.verdict: pass: overflow 0px at 768/390/320 in both shells on the built candidate; desktop 1440 geometry identical to the W13 receipt (input x 1106.4, width 128, right 1234.4); typed-focused action passes at every width; submit control clear of the input by ~4.6px at every width.

class_F_focus_assertion.route: OD-T2 G-probe: S10 tablet (768px) shell.search typed-focused captured on the G-fixed candidate, front of the browser.lock queue.
class_F_focus_assertion.result: Focus holds at assertion time: typed_and_focused true immediately after the action and true after the settle phase (1500ms + animation finish + double rAF + 300ms). The document-level focus trace in the same record shows exactly one focusout — the action-time submit -> input handoff before typing (t~4484ms) — and no focusout/focusin after the input gains focus. The same held result was recorded on the pre-fix candidate in this frame (probe-search-s10-base), consistent with E2's classification that the decay lives in the capture harness's settle phase, not the candidate; with G's overflow gone the row's containment failure is removed and no candidate-side focus defect reproduces.
class_F_focus_assertion.verdict: cured-by-G on the record evidence of this frame; no re-focusing driver used, no harness change taken.

class_B_back_control.defect: S10 credit.otherwise back-control-click fails at desktop/mobile/narrow-mobile in the audit: the click on #u-credit-otherwise .return-credits a times out because the fader close anchor intercepts pointer events (audit unconfirmed_items, literal).
class_B_back_control.mechanism: Under the saved Credit cascade the fader anchor covers the full viewport (position absolute, inset 0, 100% x 100%). At rest it paints below the modal controls; hansarp's generic link hover rule transforms and raises it (measured on hover: transform matrix(1.04856, 0.0549528, -0.0549528, 1.04856, 0, 0), z-index 2), so a real mouse path to the control puts the close anchor on top at the click point.
class_B_back_control.fix: Verbatim restore of the W13-removed certified fader block in authority-overrides.css (block sha256 bbd8cd176e69656fa84abcba9aa00bd0fee182b4c5872316d82e48a12d19561b, identical to the pre-removal ledger entry).
class_B_back_control.toggle_result: Without the block: back click FAILS (5000ms timeout, audit-identical) at 1440/390/320; hit-test after hover shows the close anchor topmost. With the block: anchor stays position absolute / z-index auto / transform none under hover, control topmost, full open-otherwise -> scroll -> back-click -> returned-to-view sequence PASSES at 1440/390/320. Confirmed again on the built candidate (probe-credit-final.json). This supports the failure being new with the W13 removal.

class_H_history_residual.defect: page.history narrow-mobile (320px) rows carry +5px document containment in both audits: table.form measures 312.5px wide at x=12 inside the 288px form (document 325px).
class_H_history_residual.fix: The existing history-options authority block's tracks repeat(3,1fr) -> repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)): the 1fr minimum (auto) was the grid items' min-content; bounding it lets the option cell fit the form.
class_H_history_residual.trials: minmax(0,1fr) alone clears both shells (document 325 -> 320, table 312.5 -> 288, form scrollWidth 309 -> 288); table-layout:fixed + width:100% alone does NOT clear it (grid cell still reaches 324.5); the combination adds nothing over minmax alone.
class_H_history_residual.function_check: At 320/390/1440 every history table cell measures scrollWidth == clientWidth (no clipped labels or controls); 390px and 1440px geometry is unchanged from the pre-fix candidate. No certified A/B bound is broken, so the certified-remedy-conflict fallback does not trigger.
